_about: House defaults from real review rounds. A preset is a starting point, not a rule: anything the user asks for in the current MV wins, and a new project may pick other values.

habits.open_on_a_shot: frame 0 shows footage, no black open
habits.text_on_sung_units: big text pops unit by unit on the sung time, tilted, off faces
habits.one_credit_place: credits either in end titles or on a freeze card, not both
habits.no_starburst: the full-frame starburst flash was rejected once
habits.post_credits_gag: optional; ask before adding one to a new MV
